test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'take this vaccine' is written as '892', 'vaccine protects us' is written as '263', and 'take us safe' is written as '593'. How will 'safe vaccine' be written in that language?
solution:
• The code for each word is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef92392efe0f642c3585382f70a593b1c959b8a0cee2932d9eac2ba4bc58f51b.png] 

safe → 5

vaccine → 2 

'safe vaccine' will be written as '52' in that language.

Hence, ‘**52**’ is the correct answer.
